subject: Earmarked capacity verification for Twilight Labs - dedicated sizing & hold request
messages:
From: Rohit Sharma <rohit@twilightlabs.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@twilightlabs.ai>
Date: 2029-04-16T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — early June launch window

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We got sign-off from product and security to proceed to a limited production rollout targeted for the first week of June. Before legal and procurement start the paperwork, I need a realistic sense of whether Redwood can earmark dedicated capacity for us for a 90-day initial period.

High-level requirements:
- Peak concurrent model sessions: ~20
- Typical throughput: ~1.2–1.8M tokens/day
- Latency target (p50): <120ms for short-turn queries
- Model family: Llama-compatible, prefer an H100-backed instance profile for QoS; fallbacks to quantized A100 are acceptable for background batch work

Can you check if there is capacity in us-west-2 for June–August that we could tentatively earmark? If possible, we want a soft hold while we finish procurement (target close: 2029-05-01). Attached is the initial capacity spreadsheet with workload profiles (capacity_request_v1.xlsx).

Also: what would the expected uplift be for guaranteed dedicated pool vs. bursty shared hosted? We need to model cost for procurement.

Appreciate the quick check — Rohit
Twilight Labs — Head of Platform
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rohit Sharma <rohit@twilightlabs.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-04-16T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — early June launch window

Rohit —

Thanks for the clear profile and timeline. Looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Ben (capacity ops) to validate fleet availability and a soft-earmark workflow. Monica — FYI on CS touchpoints and QoS expectations.

Next steps from our side:
1) Ops to run availability by SKU and region and recommend a mix (H100 vs A100).
2) Sales to confirm required SLOs + deal close target so we can attach a hold duration to the reservation.
3) If available, we’ll issue a 30-day soft-earmark ID that holds capacity while PO/SOW finalize.

I’ll coordinate a brief 30-minute call if that helps — otherwise Ben, can you take point on availability?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, Rohit Sharma <rohit@twilightlabs.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-04-16T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — early June launch window

Rohit / team —

Quick sizing read based on the numbers in capacity_request_v1.xlsx and experience with similar customers:
- Recommendation: primary pool = 6x H100-80GB nodes dedicated (sustained low-latency traffic), secondary pool = 2x A100-40GB reserved for batch/async heavy throughput spikes.
- Estimated sustained token throughput: 6x H100 with our serving runtime + prefix caching should handle ~1.5–2.0M tokens/day with p50 latency in your stated target when requests are shardable across sessions.
- KV cache: enable prefix/KV caching for persistent context to reduce per-token compute.
- Quantization profile: recommend 8-bit quantization for the A100 fallback pool; H100 should run fp16 for quality-critical queries.

Operational asks from your side:
- Confirm target close date (Rohit mentioned 2029-05-01) — we need that for the soft-earmark TTL.
- Confirm whether SLOs include p95 targets and retention window for logs (for dedicated we provide token-level billing and retention options).

Ben/Monica: please validate fleet availability in us-west-2 for a June activation and whether we can place a 30-day soft-earmark for the 8-node mix above.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Rohit Sharma <rohit@twilightlabs.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-04-17T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — early June launch window

Mina / Karthik / Rohit —

Availability check (us-west-2) as of 2029-04-17:
- Inventory snapshot: 12 H100-80GB nodes idle / allocatable across dedicated pools during June–August runway.
- Current fragmentation: most H100 capacity is in two racks; allocating 6 for a single customer will require allocating contiguous slots + affinity to avoid cross-noise. Ops can do that but it requires a reservation ticket.

Soft-earmark proposal:
- We can issue a 30-day soft-earmark (RESV-4591) that tags 6 H100 + 2 A100 for Twilight Labs. The soft-earmark prevents allocation to other customers but is revocable after TTL if PO/SOW isn't received by the end of the window.
- To create the soft-earmark we need: Deal ID (you have DL-2029-0773), expected activation date (2029-06-03), and commercial contact / PO number OR signed SOW upload.
- Cost delta: dedicated pool + contiguous-affinity premium => ~+18–22% over equivalent shared-hosted usage (final depends on network egress and retention choices). We’ll generate a ballpark add-on in the SOW draft.

Attachments: capacity_runbook_v2.pdf (ops runbook for reservation lifecycle), SOW_draft_twilight.pdf (initial commercial sketch).

Operational constraints/notes:
- If you need >6 H100 we can scale but require an extended commit or calendar flexibility — at present the contiguous H100 racks needed for low jitter are limited.
- We can provide a staged canary: allocate 2 H100 immediately for an early pilot and bring remaining 4 online at full activation to reduce lead-time risk. That can be reflected in the SOW.

Action items:
- Mina/Karthik: confirm you want the 30-day soft-earmark and provide the activation date + PO contact.
- Rohit: if SLOs include p95 <250ms please call that out so we can size padding and request affinity.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity & Infrastructure Ops, Redwood Inference
